subject.title: fix(telegram): record sent messages in the source-delivery path

question: Should this Telegram delivery fix wait for live source-delivery and reaction proof, or should a maintainer explicitly override that proof gate based on the focused synthetic evidence?
rationale: Repository policy requires real Telegram proof for this delivery and reply-context surface, but the remaining gap is proof rather than a concrete implementation defect and requires maintainer access or an explicit override.

options.title: Capture live Telegram proof
options.body: Refresh the branch, run automatic source delivery, react to the delivered message, and verify the reaction is routed as applying to a bot-owned message.

options.title: Explicitly override proof
options.body: A maintainer may accept the focused delivery, ledger, and config-scope evidence while explicitly owning the residual live integration risk.

recommendation.title: Capture live Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, run automatic source delivery, react to the delivered message, and verify the reaction is routed as applying to a bot-owned message.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is enforcement or override of a repository-level Telegram proof requirement rather than a mechanical contributor repair.
